root_cause.analysis: In scripts/test_dev_remote_guarded_exec.py, the test child script writes to result via open(str(result), 'w').write('EOF-before-mutation') and raises SystemExit(75). The test harness polls with wait_until(result.exists). Under CI runner load during the 11-minute 1814-test run, the polling loop detected the file immediately upon creation by open(..., 'w') before Python had flushed or closed the written bytes, reading an empty string ''. In local isolated testing the test passes 5/5 times in ~0.8s. The failure was a transient file-creation race under CI runner load, completely unrelated to the docs-only changes in PR #6382 (services/governance/contract.md and its evidence manifest).
